name: Crisis: Counterplay (Gold Build) by Trinity
author: MindTheGapPlz
description:
A dodge game where “crises” appear periodically. Learn skills and use rewards to survive. In the Infinite Challenge level (only when it is highlighted green), stay alive as long as you can and beat the record!
